keyFindings.description: Security[secret]: guard.go:148 redacts -pg with net/url, but pgx v5.11.0 parses with pgconn/parse_url.go (userinfo ends at the first @ before /, query split at & only, password and sslpassword secret). The guard accepts and meta.json records the credential for postgres://u:#secret@h/db, postgres://u:?pw@h/db, ?password=a;b, ?password=ab#cd (records #cd), ?sslpassword=...; a non-postgres:// scheme falls to pgx's keyword parser whose error keeps a password fragment (postgres_version_error, pgpoll). Pre-existing since the redaction began; the comment and README claim 'as pgx parses'. Fix: accept -pg only with a postgres:// or postgresql:// prefix that pgconn.ParseConfig accepts, and record it from pgx's own parse (host, port, database) or as <redacted>.
